provider: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) 3D Elevation Program / The National Map (TNMAccess)
api_version: TNM Access API v1 / USGS Seamless 1-Meter (S1M) DEM, DOI 10.5066/P13LJKFS

request_contract.parameter_rules: Exactly one explicit opt-in HTTPS GET to service root https://tnmaccess.nationalmap.gov and exact path /api/v1/products using ONLY literal query datasets=Seamless%201-m%20DEM%20%28S1M%29&bbox=-81.00,25.95,-80.95,26.00&max=1&offset=0. The fixed source/collection is Seamless 1-m DEM (S1M), not older project-based 1m DEM; the pinned Florida bbox is [-81.00,25.95,-80.95,26.00] WGS84, max=1 and offset=0. Never accept caller-selected host, source, AOI, dates, headers, pagination, extra parameters, retries, redirects, alternate URL, object download, raw GeoTIFF, metadata crawl or schedule. A successful catalogue response remains metadata-only, not CAT admission. One response may have an empty item.datasets array: its title, sourceId, exact S1M TIFF URL and AOI must match the one independently frozen record.

response_contract.format: USGS TNM Access API v1 JSON dataset catalogue and product search metadata only; no GeoTIFF or source point-cloud bytes.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: The S1M is a newer 1-meter bare-earth DEM compiled from many LiDAR projects and published in 10-km COG tiles with pixel-level source lineage. Distinct from project-based 1-meter DEM, it has incomplete and expanding coverage; advertised 1-meter pixel spacing does not imply one-meter vertical accuracy. Elevation represents terrain rather than building roof or finished-floor height; horizontal CRS, vertical datum/epoch, survey vintage, blending and source work-unit quality must be verified before hydrologic or building-overlap use.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: One manually triggered exact HTTPS GET (max=1 offset=0), no retries, redirects, concurrent calls, pagination, interval schedule, alternate areas or asset download. USGS public-domain statement does not imply a throughput entitlement. No provider bytes saved in repository, Neon or local cache.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: TNM S1M product catalogue can change; record original response SHA-256, byte count, retrieval UTC, exact GET request hash, parser and code hash, one vetted source ID and expected TIFF URL. Failure to match the pinned 2026-08-21 Florida record must block rather than search alternate tiles. Source TIFF ~447MB is not touched in this T1 metadata probe.

rights_and_policy.notes: Official USGS National Map FAQ states mapping services and downloaded data are public domain, free and unrestricted with recommended agency acknowledgement; National Map FAQ and public TNMAccess OpenAPI explicitly support developers making programmatic HTTP GET/POST requests. This review approves only one human-triggered, fixed anonymous GET retrieving public product metadata. It does NOT approve sustained/high-rate API use, provider bytes redistribution, alternate assets or original GeoTIFF downloads; preserve explicit data attribution and retain no external response body.

expected_evidence: One exact fixed request to /api/v1/products with reviewed S1M dataset, bbox, max=1, offset=0 and without redirects or credentials
HTTP 200, application/json and uncompressed content under 131072 original bytes
Strict JSON shape with exactly one product matching frozen S1M sourceId, exact title, TIFF URL, valid bounds and original collection identity
SHA-256 and byte count of original response, request fingerprint, parser/code SHA and retrieval UTC; no raw response body persisted

notes: One metadata-only, explicitly opt-in T1 route for the single verified public South Florida S1M product sourceId 6a9785801ba49b050c166274. Dataset is public-domain but any different AOI, raw COG, DEM pixel, footprint overlay, building height or insurer loss requires new source-scientific authorization. No automatic data import or Neon write follows.
